name: plasma_overview
description: Endpoint security overview: event, alert and kill counts, breakdowns by kind, severity, host and source, and top ATT&CK techniques.

name: plasma_recent
description: Most recent normalized events, newest first, optionally for one host.

limit.description: How many events to return, newest first.

host.description: Endpoint name such as WS1, WS2 or DC1.

name: plasma_alerts
description: Sentinel detections with score, action and ATT&CK technique, filterable by severity and technique.

name: plasma_processes
description: Process creation and image-load events with parent, command line and technique, filterable by host, process or user.

process.description: Process image name such as powershell.exe or p.exe.

user.description: Account that ran the process, such as CORP\\svcbackup.

name: plasma_network
description: Outbound network connections with destination IP and port, filterable by destination or port.

name: plasma_dns
description: DNS lookups grouped by query, optionally filtered by domain fragment.

name: plasma_persistence
description: Persistence indicators: registry writes, Run keys, IFEO hijacks, scheduled tasks, grouped by ATT&CK technique.

name: plasma_search
description: Free-text search across command lines, descriptions, paths, domains, users and techniques.

name: plasma_graph_overview
description: Relationship graph overview: entity nodes (hosts, processes, users, IPs, domains, files, registry, techniques) and observed edge types.

name: plasma_graph_neighbors
description: One-hop neighbors of an entity: everything connected to a host, process, user, IP, domain, file, registry path or technique.
